Publish.LongDescription:
# Planboard
Planboard is a location-aware planning board for Cities: Skylines II. Create issues, notes, and ideas, keep them as list-only tasks, or attach them directly to places in your city.
## Highlights
- Create Issue, Note, and Idea entries. - Attach entries to map points, districts, roads, and buildings. - Track Open, Doing, and Done work with clear status icons. - Organize work with priorities, built-in or custom categories, one preferred deadline calendar, search, filters, and sorting. - Show map pins as compact icons or open sticky notes. - Keep planning data inside the city save.
Planboard has no runtime mod dependencies and supports Cities: Skylines II 1.6.x.
Publish.ChangeLog:
## 0.1.0 - Initial public release
- Added location-aware issues, notes, and ideas. - Added list, detail, quick-pin, and sticky-note workflows. - Added status, priority, custom category, preferred deadline, search, filter, and sorting controls. - Added map visibility modes, marker navigation, and district quick creation. - Added recoverable deletion and resizable persistent windows. - Added versioned save data validation and repair reporting.
